content: Drift migrations: 'dart run drift_dev schema dump <db.dart> drift_schemas/' extracts a JSON snapshot of the CURRENT schema, and must be re-run on every schemaVersion bump. 'drift_dev schema generate' then produces test code that verifies a migration lands on the expected schema, and 'drift_dev schema steps' produces a stepByStep onUpgrade. The snapshot for version N can only be taken while N is the live schema — miss it and there is no verified baseline to migrate FROM, ever. A MigrationStrategy supplying only beforeOpen leaves drift's default onUpgrade, which throws in both the upgrade and downgrade directions.
